explanation: Massachusetts General Laws chapter 40P, section 4 prohibits any city or town, including Boston, from enacting, maintaining or enforcing rent control except under narrow voluntary conditions; Boston's home-rule petition for rent stabilization (H.3744) was never enacted. So no city-level rent increase limit exists in Boston.
